title: Dunhuang Papercut Dreamscape Art
description: A detailed prompt for creating a 3D layered papercut art piece inspired by Dunhuang's Mogao Caves. It features an Oriental woman entering a massive, intricately carved paper sculpture cave, with vibrant colors like peacock blue and sand gold.
promptText: 9:16 vertical version, modern oriental female dreamscape dimensional papercut art, modern oriental papercut art, layered paper cut illustration, dimensional paper sculpture, intricate paper carving, paper diorama, poetic female dreamscape. The theme of the work is 'She walks into the unfinished page of a Dunhuang mural.' A visual 24-year-old oriental adult female, mysterious, elegant, quiet and determined, walking alone along long steps in a paper-carved cave. The character has a clear oval face, slender almond eyes slightly raised, and a quiet, focused expression. Long black hair is half-draped and half-tied, with strands naturally connecting to Feitian-style paper ribbons, wearing light gold floating clouds and small flower branch hair accessories. The character wears a multi-layered paper art long dress composed of ochre, stone green, peacock blue and gold. The hem features Feitian, caisson, sand patterns and Crescent Spring-style hollow patterns. The outer layer of silk ribbons flutters lightly behind her in the wind. The clothing has clear paper thickness, fiber texture, cut edges and dense hollow structures. The scene uses a relatively simple multi-layered stage-style composition, not crowded with mural characters. The main subject is a huge, nested Dunhuang-style paper-carved cave entrance. The arched door frame occupies the main space of the picture, with a large caisson paper-carved pattern at the top as a visual anchor. Only a few Feitian paper carvings and mural character silhouettes are kept on the left and right of the door, creating a sense of a dream of civilization, but avoiding complex crowding. The character is located in a small position at the lower center of the screen, facing away or two-thirds side-facing away from the camera, walking towards the huge door along several wide paper art steps. The scale of the character is significantly smaller than the door to emphasize the massive scale of the cave. Through the door, you can directly see another opened Dunhuang dream: vast golden sand dunes, curved blue water like the Crescent Spring, distant mountains, paper art clouds and a thin moon in the sky. The dunes and water surface are formed by multiple layers of paper, and the space is open and clean, without too many buildings. The overall colors are brighter and clearer than traditional Dunhuang colors: dominated by high-saturation but high-end peacock blue, stone green, ochre and warm sand gold, with an appropriate amount of cinnabar orange-red as a visual highlight. The outer layer of the door uses ochre and gold, the middle layer adds stone green and peacock blue, the distant desert uses warm gold and light ochre, and the Crescent Spring uses a bright blue-green. Colors are clearly separated from each other, without a uniform brownish-yellow filter, not gray or dirty. The lighting uses a transition from warm inside the cave to brighter outside. Golden celestial light shines from the direction of the distant dunes and Crescent Spring, passing through the paper-carved door and falling on the steps and the character's silhouette, forming a clear but soft guiding light. The edges of the caisson, Feitian, door frame and character's ribbons have a delicate translucent feel, while the dark areas still maintain layers of peacock blue, stone green and ochre. All caves, caissons, Feitian, sand dunes, Crescent Spring, clouds, characters and clothing must be unified into a high-level dimensional paper carving language. Strengthen the real paper fibers, paper layer thickness, hand-cut edges, slight creases and inter-layer projections. The whole piece is like a high-end Dunhuang-themed paper carving art installation, rather than a common mural illustration. The overall mood is: ancient, mysterious, quiet, vast, civilization is reawakening. The focus of the picture is 'Behind a huge doorway, another page of the ancient world is reopened', the composition is simple and powerful, the character is small, the space is large, and the colors are bright and transparent. promptText:
A hyper-realistic, cinematic close-up portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="beautiful young woman with soft wavy blonde hair"} cascading over one shoulder, looking back over her shoulder toward the viewer with a serene, slightly mysterious expression. Soft volumetric neon glow, strong color contrast between the cool blue background code projections and the warm magenta/pink facial mapping, subtle skin texture and pore detail visible under the projected light, cinematic depth of field with softly blurred glowing code fragments floating in the background.
